raw_text:
Rust Titan Exchange WebSocket client library + test CLI: streaming/one-shot quotes, reconnect with exponential backoff, queued streams, Solana instruction extraction.

Commands:
```sh
cargo build --release
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- --help
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- info
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- price SOL USDC 1000000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- stream SOL USDC 1000000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- swap --keypair ~/.config/solana/id.json SOL USDC 100000000
cargo run --features cli --bin titan-cli -- watch
cargo test --test [name]
cargo clippy --all-targets
```

Architecture: `TitanClient` owns WebSocket/streams and `TitanConfig`; internally thread-safe (`Arc`). Background Tokio task dispatches messages and reconnects. `StreamManager` queues at `concurrentStreams`; `active_count` tracks slots. Shared `Arc<AtomicBool>` `slot_released` ensures exactly one decrement across user `stop()`/`Drop`, server `StreamEnd`, or reconnect failure. `ResumableStream.on_end` bridges server endings to queue accounting; reconnect updates `effective_stream_id: Arc<AtomicU32>` so `QuoteStream` stops the remapped ID.

Files: `src/lib.rs` entry/re-exports; `src/client.rs` client API; `src/config.rs` config; `src/connection.rs` WebSocket/resumption; `src/error.rs` errors; `src/state.rs` state/observer; `src/stream.rs` QuoteStream/CAS guard; `src/queue.rs` manager; `src/instructions.rs` Solana conversion/ALT (feature `solana`); `src/tls.rs` secure/dangerous TLS; `src/bin/titan_cli.rs` CLI.

CLI env: `TITAN_URL` (CLI default `wss://us1.api.demo.titan.exchange/api/v1/ws`; library default `wss://api.titan.ag/api/v1/ws`), required `TITAN_TOKEN`, `SOLANA_RPC_URL` (default `https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com`), `TITAN_DANGER_ACCEPT_INVALID_CERTS` (dev only). Config defaults: max reconnect delay 30,000ms; attempts unlimited; auto-wrap SOL false; invalid certs false; one-shot timeout 10,000ms; ping/pong from connection defaults.

API: `new_swap_quote_stream(SwapQuoteRequest) -> Result<QuoteStream>`; `get_swap_price(SwapQuoteRequest) -> Result<SwapQuotes>` (first quote, auto-stop, timeout); `get_swap_price_simple(SwapPriceRequest) -> Result<SwapPrice>`; `get_info()`, `get_venues()`, `list_providers()`, state/connection observers and checks, `wait_for_connected()`, `close()`, `is_closed()`, active/queued counts. `TitanInstructions` prepares routes, fetches ALTs, converts single/batch instructions. Streaming may send empty initial `quotes`, especially dummy pubkeys; don't assert nonempty without a real wallet.

`WorkerServiceState` shared axum singleton holds `Arc<TitanClient>`.

Rules:
- **Maximum file size: ~200 lines** - Split larger files
- **mod.rs files should be empty** - Only contain mod declarations, move content to meaningful file names
- Use helper structs with static methods for clear separation (e.g., `TitanHelper::method()`)
- Single error enum for the crate (`TitanClientError`)
- All fallible operations return `Result`
- **Never panic** - Always propagate errors via Result
- Use typed variants for recoverable errors (auth, rate limit), anyhow for unexpected
- Use native `async fn` directly
- No boxed futures or `async-trait` unless absolutely necessary
- Tokio-only (no runtime-agnostic abstractions)
- Use `pub` everywhere for simplicity
- Use `#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]` on public methods
- **No inline log statements** - Spans provide enough context
- Remove `println!`, `dbg!`, and most `tracing::info!` statements
- Keep only `tracing::error!` and `tracing::warn!` for critical issues
- Minimal doc comments; only document non-obvious behavior
- Consolidate constants; remove magic numbers
- Re-export `titan-api-types` types directly (no wrapper types)
- Enable Solana conversion features

Features: `solana` default-on; `cli` default-off. docs.rs uses `default-features = false`. See `FOR_USER.md` for architecture details.
